methods.name: public static int skipUntil(String input, int pos, String characters)
methods.comment:
* Returns the next index in {@code input} at or after {@code pos} that
   * contains a character from {@code characters}. Returns the input length if
   * none of the requested characters can be found.

methods.name: public static int skipWhitespace(String input, int pos)
methods.comment:
* Returns the next non-whitespace character in {@code input} that is white
   * space. Result is undefined if input contains newline characters.

methods.name: public static int parseSeconds(String value, int defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* Returns {@code value} as a positive integer, or 0 if it is negative, or
   * {@code defaultValue} if it cannot be parsed.
